source.member: Fellowship.CalculateXPSharing() (private), Fellowship.GetMemberSharePercent() (internal), Fellowship.SplitXp(ulong, XpType, ShareType, Player)
source.notes: the first case (op table) records the synthetic CharacterLevelXPList in its input. Then one case per fellowship: in.members = [[guid, level, cell, x, y], ...] in FellowshipMembers order (the first is the leader), in.earner the index of the member who earned, in.leader_online whether the leader is in PlayerManager's online players, in.desired_share_xp, in.quest_bonus the fellow_quest_bonus setting, in.amount (ulong), in.xp_type and in.share_type as ints. out.share_xp / out.even_share after CalculateXPSharing, out.percent = GetMemberSharePercent(), out.grants = the Player.GrantXP calls SplitXp made, in order: [guid, amount (long), xpType, shareType].
